Hi all —

Attaching a short unit-economics summary (inline below) to help with procurement discussions. High-level assumptions: we assume interactive workload (p95 latency target 400ms), and that EdgeFin will accept a burst policy that allows ~1.5x normal TPS for short windows.

Unit economics (example):
- Hosted public tier list price: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Committed monthly tier (200M+): $900 / 1M tokens (10–25% effective discount depending on commit length)
- Enterprise commit + burst protection (SLA + reserved capacity): $650–$800 / 1M tokens depending on commitment & term

Example monthly math for 250M tokens:
- At $900 / 1M => $225,000 / month
- At $650 / 1M => $162,500 / month

Recommendations:
- If EdgeFin's monthly budget target is <$200k, recommend starting with a 200M commit at ~$650–$750 /1M tokens (enterprise commit) or use a committed mid-tier (200M) at $900/1M with flexibility during ramp.
- Set burst buffer to 1.5x (we can gate burst by cost or strict token caps) — plan capacity to handle up to ~60 TPS for transient spikes.

Marissa — happy to convert this into a one-pager to attach to the SOW.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
